_comment: Final review, integration finding 3. `PR_PHASES` is typed `readonly PrPhase[]` ON PURPOSE, so `.includes(untrustedString)` cannot compile and a caller is pushed to `isPrPhase` instead of casting the input. This project MUST FAIL, and prphase.test.ts asserts the exact code — otherwise a future widening of PR_PHASES to `readonly string[]` would quietly make the double-cast shape legal again.
